name: Pim
role: Adult moth-folk signal keeper, fourth summon
locks: Round fluffy face, huge black eyes without whites, one highlight each, tiny expressive mouth, no nose or human hair.
Two 30 cm feathery antennae rising from forehead, cream with lilac tips.
Exactly two arms and two legs; long thin grey-lilac chitin limbs.
Each hand has three long fingers and one thumb, four digits total.
Two pairs of dusty cream wings, lilac and pale grey eye-spots, folded to backs of knees in rest form.
Fitted lilac vest, small brass buttons, round unlettered brass signal-mirror badge.
Fine brass wire coils on both wrists; satchel of brass tuning forks.
Black over-ear headset, cracked band, dead light ring, antennae through band gap.

execution_choices.satchel: Anatomical left hip on a strap over the right shoulder.

forms.rest: Wings folded, 200 m listening range, gate signals any range.
forms.field: Four wings open to 2.6 m, eye-spots glow lilac, antennae blaze, faint lilac signal rings; 20 km listening range, gate signals any range. No sustained flight; wing-assisted bounds.

status: Front failed after five attempts; best retained. Remaining five sheets not completed.
unresolved_faults: Lower wing pair extends into upper calves rather than ending at backs of knees.
Two small nose-like marks appear above the separate mouth.
reference_policy: Approved A3_P23 acting image used only as style anchor. An intermediate turnaround used own front try3 before its enlarged digit check failed; both were rejected and were not reused. No rejects used as generation inputs.
